benchmarks.name: OCP artifact
benchmarks.paper_scope: coverage and mutation-oriented TCP artifact with OCP and comparator results
benchmarks.matrix_semantics: coverage entity or mutant/fault proxy; must be verified per file
benchmarks.duration_source: artifact prioritization-time data exists but is not per-test execution duration and must not be used for APFDc
heavy_steps: unzip subject programs and test suites if raw matrices are inside archives
re-run Java artifact only after confirming original input paths and metric protocol
benchmarks.accuracy_gate: confirm whether each matrix column is statement, branch, method, mutant, or fault before reporting

benchmarks.name: FAST artifact
benchmarks.paper_scope: similarity/diversity TCP artifact with fault matrices and coverage representations
benchmarks.matrix_semantics: C fault matrix is test->faults; Java fault matrix is bug/version->faulty tests; coverage text files are representation entities
benchmarks.duration_source: FAST timing results are prioritization/runtime metrics, not per-test execution durations
heavy_steps: isolate old Python/scipy environment if reproducing FAST baselines
benchmarks.accuracy_gate: record exact commit and preserve C-vs-Java fault matrix schema before running comparisons

benchmarks.name: SIR program repository
benchmarks.paper_scope: small subject programs for regression testing research
benchmarks.adapter: benchmark-specific converter after object package inspection
benchmarks.matrix_semantics: fault matrix if package exposes one; otherwise generated coverage/fault proxy
heavy_steps: download object packages and confirm license/access constraints
build subject-specific matrix from package tooling if no matrix is shipped
benchmarks.accuracy_gate: do not report SIR results until package format and matrix semantics are recorded

benchmarks.name: Defects4J
benchmarks.paper_scope: real-bug Java benchmark; matrix must be generated
benchmarks.adapter: scripts/build_defects4j_trigger_matrix.py for cross-bug trigger smoke; per-bug rank aggregator still required for reportable trigger evidence
benchmarks.matrix_semantics: bug id columns span separate buggy revisions for trigger smoke; coverage or mutation entities for heavier variants
benchmarks.duration_source: generated by test execution if needed; not provided by default
heavy_steps: run relevant tests, coverage, or mutation
record Java, Perl, timezone, and Defects4J commit
benchmarks.accuracy_gate: start with trigger smoke for 3-5 bugs; report per-bug rank/TTFF with tests.all or tests.relevant before public claims; mutation is development-machine only

benchmarks.name: TCPFramework / RTPTorrent
benchmarks.paper_scope: CI-history benchmark with modern non-RL TCP combinators
benchmarks.matrix_semantics: CI-history failure proxy, not direct ground-truth fault matrix
benchmarks.duration_source: framework metrics include cost-aware CI evaluation
benchmarks.accuracy_gate: preserve temporal split and mark failure clusters as proxies
